report.explanation: All 12 checkout observations returned HTTP 200 with durations 47-297ms; traces show successful downstream calls and no errors. Metrics show 0 502s and no dependency failures. The single 297ms outlier is not established as a fault, and no evidence supports any taxonomy cause (no 500s, pool exhaustion, redis timeout, memory leak, or bad config). Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; handing off.
